description.value: Wild Renfrew is a multi-unit coastal resort in Port Renfrew at the southern terminus of the West Coast Trail, where forest, river, and sea converge roughly two hours from Victoria. The property spans seaside cottages, forest-view domes, studios with hot tubs, and a hostel-style lodge, making it one of the more complete accommodation options at the remote western end of Vancouver Island. An on-site pub serves food and drinks year-round, which is notable given how few services exist in this area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and matches the OSM record for name and phone number. The website explicitly lists an on-site pub (Renfrew Pub) as within walking distance, confirming nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific services, laundry, or most other amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content; OSM's internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed via the website text so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules. A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM records 17310 Parkinson Road while the website states check-in is at 17293 Parkinson Road.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records 17310 Parkinson Road, but the website explicitly states 'Our accommodation check in & gift shop address is 17293 Parkinson Road'. The website value should be verified and the OSM record corrected if needed.
